collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: Content note: the owner's per-event content note (the per-event content-notes feature shows it), never part of a page
the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A villager notices that several graves of villagers with no living family have become overgrown.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1) notices that several graves of villagers with no living family have become overgrown.

choices.label: Learn the Stories of Those Buried.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The graves look cared for again, and the villager feels a sense of peace.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The work is harder than expected, and the villager returns over several days.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Several villagers join, and they share memories of those buried there.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some villagers feel uneasy around graves, and the villager does not press them.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The flowers bloom, and others begin leaving small tokens.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The flowers wilt in the heat, and the villager tries hardier plants.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: An elder remembers each one and shares their stories.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Nobody remembers some of them, and the villager decides that they are still worth tending.
